rationale: The plan correctly identifies the 2x2 factorial, keeps time as a two-level factor rather than using time_hours, fits ~ condition + time + condition:time with explicit reference levels, and makes the Wald test on the interaction coefficient the primary result with ashr-shrunken simple effects at each time point, matching the reference exactly. QC (blind vst, PCA, distances, library sizes, flag-not-drop policy), the justified 10-counts-in-3-samples filter, in-model median-of-ratios normalization, BH at 0.05 with independent filtering and thresholds tested in the model are all stated explicitly. Enrichment is correctly omitted, and the report specifies method, versions, design, thresholds, n_tested, n_DE, NA causes, and design caveats (low interaction power, lost length offset). Minor deductions only for the odd self-imposed prohibition on an edgeR QL robustness check and a small path typo in Step 2; the QC does not mention batch coloring, though a single batch makes that moot.
